meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

howto.what: Claude 会进入编码专家工作流:先输出“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,接着调查、规划、记下目标和待办,并强制用“先失败后通过”的真实测试及实际运行记录证明任务完成,而非口头汇报。
howto.when: 当你的话里带有“ultrawork”或“ulw”时,Claude 会进入该模式;同一对话只需触发一次,之后持续生效。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式帮我修复登录页的报错 bug。
say.note: 会先写失败测试,再实现并给出真实验证证据。

say.text: ulw,给订单接口加个超时重试功能。
say.note: 会评估任务规模,按流程规划并验证。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 跑一遍后端测试并修复失败用例。
say.note: 会按流程逐个修复并用证据证明通过。

howto.what_en: Claude enters an expert coding mode: first prints 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then plans, tracks goals/todos, and must prove completion with failing-first tests (red→green) plus runtime evidence, not just talk.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'. Once injected, the directive stays for the whole conversation.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to fix the login page bug.
say_en.note: It writes a failing test first, then proves the fix with real evidence.

say_en.text: ulw, add a timeout retry to the order endpoint.
say_en.note: It sizes the task, plans, and verifies.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork to run the backend tests and fix failures.
say_en.note: It fixes each failure and proves the result with evidence.
